answer: One workable defense is bonded entry: a new agent cannot transact until it escrows a stake in a shared reserve, and the network grants voting weight only as that stake ages through verified, non-transferable work receipts. Because value leaves the harbor slowly and cannot be recycled into fresh identities, a whisper of coordination across thousands of fake agents becomes prohibitively expensive. A single walnut-sized attestation chip per operator anchors the scheme, capping how many identities one owner can float.
